evidence.observation: Tube pressure gauge is not installed; required growth-stage pressure verification is unavailable.
Exhaust O2 was 1.7 ppm at the start of growth.
Exhaust O2 has risen persistently to 25.3 ppm during growth, raising concern about atmosphere integrity without identifying a cause.
Temperature 749.5 °C and Ar flow 100.3 sccm track their setpoints, but pressure is unavailable, so these readings cannot establish correct atmosphere conditions.

args.missing_evidence: A functioning tube pressure gauge is required to verify the growth atmosphere; validated O2 limits and an independent atmosphere/leak and exhaust-path check would help interpret the rising O2. Sample characterization is not yet available.
